en.title: Start a game folder for an agent with one command
en.body: node tools/egret.mjs new <folder> --target web|mobile|wechat|steam makes a small whole game to start from: rules in src/rules.mjs tested in Node, the picture drawn with play, an engine copy with the guide, and AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and a Claude Code skill that say how to work on it for that target. A game can make another beside it from its own engine copy.

zh.title: 一个命令为智能体建好游戏目录
zh.body: node tools/egret.mjs new <目录> --target web|mobile|wechat|steam 生成一个可以直接开始的小而完整的游戏：src/rules.mjs 里的规则在 Node 里测试，画面用 play 画，带指南的引擎副本，以及按目标平台写好的 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 和 Claude Code 技能。游戏还可以用自己的引擎副本在旁边再建一个游戏。
